data_point: Active careers page with several open roles
run_when: A careers page was found but no known job board, so roles couldn't be counted.

prompt.task: Count the open roles listed on the careers page and decide whether there are several (3 or more).
yes_when: 3 or more distinct open roles are listed
no_when: The page says no open roles, or lists 1 or 2
unknown_when: Roles load from elsewhere and aren't in the text
watch_out_for: Don't count the same role twice for different locations
'We're always hiring' with no roles listed is unknown

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Open roles: Senior Engineer, Product Designer, Account Executive, Customer Success Lead

output.evidence_quote: Senior Engineer, Product Designer, Account Executive, Customer Success Lead
